sentence: Smilaria fills the room. Your lowkeyoui is enough — stay seated.

wombos.definition: The radiant, hilarious aura of a person whose smile and energy fill a room — a charismatic presence that is both funny and warm.
wombos.example: She walked in and her smilaria had everyone loosening up immediately.

wombos.definition: A subdued or understated ouu-shi reaction — the quiet, internal acknowledgment of something impressive or attractive, felt but not loudly expressed.
wombos.example: I didn't say anything, but it was lowkeyoui when she walked past.
